Lina (CS): Orchid Support reported a fairly concerning repro where embeddings appear to return stale/other-tenant vectors after a scale-up. They provided steps and logs, pasting below — flagging for eng + PM triage.

Orchid Support: repro steps (customer-provided)
1) POST /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-3b and body {"input": "customer A doc"} -> returns vector A
2) Immediately POST /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-3b and body {"input": "customer B doc"} -> returns vector A (not B)
3) After a few seconds, requests return correct results again.

Logs snippet from their dedicated pool (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T15:12:01Z] req=0x7fa3 ttl=0.120 svc=kvcache route=/embeddings tenant=orchid pool=d-32 node=3 key=embedding:sha256:abcd
[2026-03-16T15:12:01Z] cache HIT -> returning cached vector (orig-tenant=orchid)
[2026-03-16T15:12:02Z] req=0x7fa4 svc=embed route=/embeddings tenant=verge pool=d-32 node=3 key=embedding:sha256:abcd
[2026-03-16T15:12:02Z] cache HIT -> returned vector (orig-tenant=orchid)
```

Observed: customers A/B on same dedicated pool briefly see other tenant vectors. Happens after scale-up (autoscale event) and persists ~2-10s.

Arjun (Eng): Thanks Lina — this sounds like a cache key collision or missing tenant namespace on the kvcache layer. Two quick clarifying q's:
- Which runtime version is the pool running? (we recently rolled 2026.03.10 -> includes kvcache refactor)
- Can the customer reproduce on a single-node pool (no autoscale)?
- Do they have per-tenant prefix config enabled?

Lina (CS): Pool is d-32-2026.03.10 (matches recent roll). Customer repro'd on autoscale only; single-node did not reproduce. They say they don't set any per-tenant prefix manually — using defaults.

Priya (PM): Flagging as high priority: cross-tenant data exposure even transiently is a product/security risk. We need to treat as urgent. Scope questions:
- Minimal acceptance criteria for a fix? (no cross-tenant hits observed in regen tests + regression test)
- Rollout strategy for Dedicated pools in prod (can we flip a config, or do we need a code patch rolled everywhere?)

Diego (SRE): From logs it looks like the cache key hashed to the same bucket and the code path that adds tenant prefix might not have executed on scale-in/scale-up path. Quick mitigation we can offer customers: set env `KVCACHE_TENANT_PREFIX=true` in their dedicated config to force namespacing (requires restart). Lina, can you push that as a temporary workaround?

Arjun (Eng): I'll try to reproduce on our staging dedicated fleet. If it's the refactor, we probably missed a path that initializes per-request tenant metadata for the kvcache warm-up code. Fix will likely be: ensure tenant is part of cache key generation before any prefetch/warmup insert. Estimate: 1 day to reproduce + patch + unit tests, 1 day for QA + rollout in canary, then 2-3 days to roll to all dedicated pools depending on change window.

Priya (PM): Proposed priority = P0 (security exposure), blocker for next Dedicated maintenance window. Acceptance criteria:
- Patch that guarantees tenant-scoped cache keys for all warmup/prefetch code paths
- Automated regression test that simulates concurrent tenants + autoscale and asserts no cross-tenant cache hits
- Backfill migration/cleanup plan (if any stale cache entries need invalidation)
- Rollout plan with canary and fast rollback

Lina (CS): Customer is ok with restart workaround for now; they'd like ETA and a way to be notified when fix ships. They've opened support ticket CS-3421 and want to be on the patch watchlist.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-3421 (OrchidCrossTenantEmbed) -> linked to internal ticket tracker.

Arjun (Eng): Action items from eng side:
- I will reproduce on staging (task: ENG-embed-534) and attach minimal repro script.
- If repro succeeds, open GH issue with labels [bug, security, dedicated, p0] and link CS-3421.
- Build patch to include tenant id in cache key generation path (including warmup code), add unit + integration tests.

Diego (SRE): Action items from SRE/ops:
- Draft customer-facing workaround instructions to set `KVCACHE_TENANT_PREFIX=true` and restart pool (include command).
- Prepare canary pool for rollout and monitoring dashboard (token-level metrics + cache hit patterns).

Priya (PM): I'm adding this to the roadmap as a hotfix for Dedicated. I'll create a short spec with launch criteria: patch in prod canary for 48h with zero cross-tenant hits, docs updated, CS notifications sent.

Lina (CS): I'll reply to CS-3421 with ETA window (EOD + 48h repro/patch estimate) and add customer to watchlist.

Arjun (Eng): Minimal repro script I'm going to run (will paste once done). For tracking I'm creating GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4860 (placeholder — will update).

Priya (PM): If eng confirms root cause quick, we should treat as hotfix outside normal sprint to avoid delay.

Lina (CS): Thanks all. Tagging @Orchid Support so they see the plan.

Orchid Support: appreciate quick triage — please keep us posted, can provide additional logs if needed.

(End thread)
